adjudication_summary: Worker-6 re-adjudicated dispatch-006-PILOT20-014-worker-5 and confirmed that worker-5 performed an analysis-layer mechanism repair, not just a recommendation. The repaired mechanism ontology was mirrored into packet and canonical final artifacts because it uses only allowed evidence classes, preserves unknown/not-tested mechanism limits, and keeps phenotype evidence distinct from the DMSO-limited direct inter-peptide NMR claim. Database-only rows, broad DRAMP conflicts, heatmap quantification limits, unresolved cellular mechanism, and legacy nonblocking material-gap labels remain explicit cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Accepted with cautions: packet status still records material_extracted_with_gaps, but true_review_result, material inventory, extraction status, and local source files show the XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database surfaces needed for this re-adjudication were present and inspected.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Accepted with cautions: previously adjudicated database-only rows and broad DRAMP conflicts remain preserved rather than converted to source_verified; no new database hard rework was introduced by the mechanism dispatch.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Accepted with cautions: the six Table S5 MIC rows remain source-located; cancer-cell heatmaps and doxorubicin-sensitization contexts are not converted into unsupported exact numeric activity rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Accepted with cautions after worker-5 repair: five claims use only phenotype_supported, direct_mechanism, and unknown_or_not_tested. The sole direct_mechanism claim is limited to DMSO NMR inter-peptide interaction with direct assay types; cellular target, membrane, nucleic-acid, protein-synthesis, and antimicrobial killing mechanisms remain unknown/not tested.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: dispatch-006-PILOT20-014-worker-5 is closed as accepted_with_cautions because the owner-updated analysis artifact was mirrored safely and no hard rework targets remain after source-bounded mechanism classification.

caution_findings.note: DBAASP rows for panel organisms or human cell lines without exact concentration/unit remain database context only and are not promoted into primary activity rows.
Broad DRAMP Antimicrobial/Anticancer annotations remain preserved as source-conflict cautions where local source material does not support exact row-level assay values.
Cancer-cell proliferation and doxorubicin-sensitization heatmaps remain qualitative/source-located context; exact per-dose activity rows were not fabricated.

The paper states that Rb reduction mechanism, cell entry, and membrane-receptor action are not known; no direct cellular target, membrane-permeabilization, protein-synthesis, nucleic-acid-binding, or antimicrobial killing mechanism assay was located.
The only direct mechanism claim is the felipeptin A1/A2 inter-peptide interaction from DMSO NMR titration; it is not promoted to a physiological cellular mechanism.
Legacy packet extraction status still says material_extracted_with_gaps, but the XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database sources needed for this dispatch were present and inspected.
